description: In every PA-model, any beta code \((c,d)\), length \(n\) and value \(a\) admit a code \((c^{\prime},d^{\prime})\) with value \(a\) at \(n\) and the same decoded values as \((c,d)\) at every \(i\lt n\). The length and indices may be nonstandard.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.beta_extension_model.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (c d n a : M) :
  ∃ c' d',
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c' d' n a ∧
      ∀ (i : M),
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
            (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) n →
          ∀ (z : M),
            Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c' d' i z ↔
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.decodeRealizes
                Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph c d i z
